population: 16 upcoming ATP main-tour singles matches in Oddset feed, 21–23 October 2026; Hard verified through current events metadata

picks.rationale: Stort prisutrymme mot modellerna och högre etablerad nivå. Dagens vinst mot Damm bekräftad i ATP-flödet; Chidekhs form är den främsta invändningen.
Modellerna gör honom till favorit trots outsiderpris. Dagens seger över Rublev bekräftad i ATP-flödet. Basilashvilis 8–2 i senaste tio registrerade matcher inklusive kval motiverar försiktighet.
Starkare hardcourt-Elo och 26–13 i registrerade hardcourt-matcher 2026. Jacquet är 7–3 senaste tio inklusive kval och har slagit Berrettini här.

excluded: Machac: 4–6 last ten registered matches vs Khachanov 7–3; Mannarino chosen instead after current ATP result confirmation. Dzumhur: challenger-level winning run vs Bergs recent Shanghai round of 16 incl Alcaraz win. Altmaier: 5–13 on registered hardcourt matches in 2026 vs Gojo strong current qualifying form.
limitations: Subjective shortlist after TA-EV screening, not a strict top-three model ranking.
TA/GPT prices include existing 5% probability markup and are not independent confirmations.
EV uses margin-free TA probability; it is conditional on model accuracy.
Historical dates are event start dates; same-event order is inferred by round.
Form includes qualifying, Challenger and Davis/Laver Cup matches, Completed/Aborted, excludes walkovers.
Database history is behind current results; ATP live feed confirms Cerundolo vs Damm and Mannarino vs Rublev.
No comprehensive verified injury assessment; Hard Elo does not distinguish indoor/outdoor.
Minimum odds are subjective thresholds allowing for form/model uncertainty, not outputs of a validated calibration.
sources: Direct MariaDB PLAYER_ODDS, WIN_PROBABILITY_TA, players, matches, events
